claim_ceiling: A bounded whole-content development nomination, not a complete reading, selected experiment, semantic result or confirmed word. Exact old hypothetical values are constraints, not evidence for their own truth.
title: RAW complete paired f83r embedded notes as a frozen91 music role-and-continuation extension
summary: Before opening either text body, nominate BOTH entire GDT790 embedded records Q1 .47–49 and Q2 .52–55,11+16 owned ZL groups. A tightly bounded extension must express part/performer reference and continued performance with all91 music meanings unchanged, preserving the distinction between singer entry and pes part start. No graphic object is interpreted as a singer or score.

design.ownership: GDT790 PANEL_RECORD_SPECS and13_PANEL_RECORD_BINDINGS map two separate embedded whole records to the same lower panel as P4/P5. Their prose/instruction role is still hypothetical. Complete source text resides in GDT790_123_IMAGE_AWARE_LINES.tsv and original guarded transcription. Reader completeness must be checked before body retrieval; no alternate reader or RF presence is presumed.
design.selection: Both embedded records under the already chosen parent panel, by fixed record metadata. Do not select only the one with convenient words. This nomination has not opened their raw bodies, compared their vocabulary or chosen clause boundaries.
design.frozen_family: GDT1026 src/SOURCE.json all71 old entries plus20 new entries, all150 parent positions, all clauses, all role/part/cue and four rhythm-branch conventions unchanged. No silent change of pending-singer scope or NEXT_FOLLOWER extent.
design.whole_content_hypothesis: The pair are two short instructions attached to the main performance account: one resolves which already named performer or part a local instruction concerns; the other tells that already assigned part to continue or restart through another singer's entry. Together they must reuse existing role/part identities and a written dependency, rather than naming two independent miniature performances. This specific content is a guess; panel proximity contributes no semantic evidence.
design.distinct_consequence: A literal ENTER applied to either pes performer is undefined in the frozen family, whereas START_PART is permitted; a continuing pes cycle cannot be restarted just because another rota singer ENTERS. Conversely any written ROTA singer role must retain its own cue owner. A complete27-group draft must bind the actual written actor, part and trigger so that these distinctions constrain an inherited state, not merely restate one free new gloss.
rivals: SHARED_PERFORMANCE: both complete notes address the parent performance and its existing roles, with all required references made explicit.
SEPARATE_PERFORMANCES: each note may introduce one separate performance only if an overt written constructor does so; the corresponding new identities and time origins are counted.

NOMINAL_LABELS: one or both units may be nonexecuting captions. Do not assume every short record contains an imperative; if all content becomes naming only, no performance-state discriminator is claimed.

prospective_budget.stop_rule: If completeness, exact whole lexical capacity or full content cannot meet the cap, retain both complete attempts and stop. Do not replace Q1/Q2, enlarge the cap or invent a role from a picture.

predecessors.limit: Whole external panel/record ownership only, no translated role or direction.
Fixed literal whole-pes serializer contradicted; no reuse or widening of that code.
150 groups and91 guessed meanings coherent only conditionally; qoky event-boundary convention and reader sar/sor/packing conflicts remain.
Prior music continuation selections exposed f111r and f76v. This is a different preselected complete paired local record, not a new crossleaf holdout.

design.strongest_countercase: Neither metadata nor the parent music account makes these graphical-area records musical instructions. Almost all27 groups may be outside the frozen inventory, or their complete values may force independent references. The old music model already fits many hand-supplied scopes; another small fitted caption could add no meaningful restriction.
design.next_step_if_selected: First freeze reader availability and all seven source loci as one paired27-group scope, then inspect only those owned text bodies. Produce complete alternatives and explicit state/reference dependencies; no source-score simulator or picture inspection.
